c.title: $4,000 / 3br - Charming Detached Home in the Heart of Kitsilano - Entire Home (Vancouver)
c.description:
Charming Detached Home in the Heart of Kitsilano - Entire Home

1944 West 5th Avenue, Vancouver, BC

$4,000/month | 3 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | Approx. 1,330 Sq. Ft. | Available Now or December 1st

Welcome to this charming entire detached home in the highly desirable Kitsilano neighbourhood, offering comfortable living space, beautifully refinished hardwood floors on the main floor, and both front and back yards.

The home has been freshly painted, with hardwood floors that have just been professionally sanded and refinished.

Property Features:

* Entire detached house
* Approximately 1,330 sq. ft. across two levels
* 3 bedrooms
* 2 full bathrooms
* Bright, functional kitchen
* Separate dining room and spacious living room
* Beautifully refinished hardwood floors (main floor)
* Fresh interior paint
* In-suite laundry
* Front porch
* Private front and back yards
* Outdoor garden space, ideal for gardening enthusiasts
* Approximately 605 sq. ft. unfinished basement offering additional storage space
* Plenty of character and charm

Additional Details:

* Rent: $4,000 per month
* Available now or December 1st
* Entire home included
* Utilities not included
* Street parking by residential permit
* Pets may be considered
* Professionally managed

Located in one of Vancouver’s most sought-after neighbourhoods, this home offers convenient access to local shops, cafés, restaurants, parks, beaches, and transit.

Floor Plan: Please note that the floor plan provided is for reference purposes only. The home has undergone bathroom renovations, so the current layout differs slightly from what is shown. The approximate square footage remains the same.

To Arrange a Viewing:

Please send a brief introduction about yourself, including:

* Who would be living in the home
* Your occupation and employment situation
* Your preferred move-in date
* Whether you have any pets

We look forward to hearing from you!
